blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas won’t be having the services of forward Gelo Crisostomo for a while in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. But when the Growling Tigers needed production from the forward position against the University of the East, they didn’t feel the void left by Crisostomo. They had Mark Llemit to thank for that. “When we found out about Gelo, we all talked as a team, especially us who’s in the same position as him,” Llemit said after their 98-87 win over the Red Warriors at Mall […]...
